name: X1 clamp-in-place, new local a
subs:
latAcc = fixedmult(
        (0x20000 < ((__builtin_abs(slipAngle) < minSlipAngle) ?
                    minSlipAngle : __builtin_abs(slipAngle))) ?
        0x20000 :
        ((__builtin_abs(slipAngle) < minSlipAngle) ? minSlipAngle : __builtin_abs(slipAngle)),
        roadGrip) / 2;
